items.text: Puka Nacua listed QUESTIONABLE (calf) for Sunday; will test pregame per McVay. Status crucial for DFS slate.
items.why: Calf; felt lack of power/explosion, majority Thursday practice then DNP Friday, pregame test
items.implication: If OUT, targets funnel to Higbee primary then Mumpfield/Parkinson/Atwell; Stafford pass yards down, run-heavy lean
items.opportunity: Tyler Higbee TE1 upside, Kyren/Corum boost, Parkinson low-end TE1

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed QUESTIONABLE (ankle) for Sunday vs Bengals. Crucial DFS status.
items.why: High ankle sprain; returned to practice limited, 'heading in the right direction' but limp noted earlier
items.implication: If OUT, Ravens offense limited; Flowers/Andrews/Henry impacted

items.text: Breece Hall listed QUESTIONABLE (quad) for Sunday vs MIA after limited practices. Crucial status.
items.why: Quad; missed 3 games, returned limited Thu/Fri, GTD to Sunday
items.implication: If ACTIVE vs soft MIA, start immediately; if OUT, Allen primary RB2
items.opportunity: Full role reclaim if plays, timeshare with Allen

items.text: 49ers ruled out Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel for Sunday in Atlanta. Also Nick Bosa etc.
items.why: Evans Achilles, Deebo hamstring; Shanahan confirm
items.implication: Dire WR situation funnels to Kittle/CMC; CMC slot looks possible
items.opportunity: George Kittle massive target share, CMC WR/RB hybrid upside

items.text: Josh Jacobs listed IN for Sunday.
items.implication: Start but Berry hates workload question post-layoff vs DET

items.text: Saquon Barkley looks set to return Week 7 vs DAL. If active, goes right back into fantasy lineups.
items.why: Hamstring return to practice; Stephania Bell agree start if out there

items.text: Seahawks ruled out RB Zach Charbonnet for SNF vs Chiefs.
If Breece Hall plays vs MIA, goes right back into starting lineup despite Stephania Bell caution on straight return.
If Puka Nacua (calf) can't go, Stafford hierarchy: 1. Tyler Higbee 2. Konata Mumpfield 3. Colby Parkinson 4. Tutu Atwell 5. Jordan Whittington 6. Davis Allen.
items.why: Dire WR situation without Puka; opportunity data focus
items.implication: Higbee primary TE/WR hybrid target; RBs/TEs get more volume, Stafford yards -10-15
items.opportunity: Higbee top-10 TE, Parkinson push TE1, Kyren/Corum boost

items.text: Brian Robinson OUT; 49ers DvP inflates opposing RB by 4.4% (7th-most). Sweet setup for Bijan Robinson full workload vs SF. Recent RB receptions to White/Holani/Harvey/Love.
items.why: BRob hamstring OUT; SF soft vs RBs recent
items.implication: Bijan clear RB1 with full snaps/carries/routes

items.text: George Kittle will go nuts vs ATL: scheme + entire 49ers WR corps hurt (Evans/Deebo OUT). Tempted by CMC more slot looks with Kaelon Black present despite rarely buying RB-as-WR hype.
items.why: WR injuries create funnel; CMC smile on slot question
items.implication: Kittle elite TE1 lock; CMC ceiling boost via routes
items.opportunity: Kittle target monster, CMC snaps/routes expansion
items.conflict: Rarely buy RB-WR statements but situation dire

items.text: The more I watch Jaylen Warren, the more I love his game. Steelers have something special.
Luther Burden 68.8% routes, elite 2.56 YPRR; Kmet IR may reduce 2/3-sets for more juice. TreVeyon Henderson only 21% snaps L3 weeks.
items.why: Route/YPRR data + Kmet IR; Henderson snap share low
items.implication: Burden breakout juice; fade/monitor Henderson role
items.opportunity: Burden route increase post-Kmet; Henderson limited

items.text: LOVE Matthew Golden vs Lions secondary (3rd-highest deep completion % allowed). Golden leads league deep targets.
